versions.changelog:
microtypography v0.1.1

- Added initial changelog and LICENSE files for better documentation and clarity.
- Updated documentation: improved skill description, input/output guidelines, workflow, and expanded rules in SKILL.md.
- Extended triggers: Figma node support (microtypography pass on selected text layers).
- Clarified input handling, language/script detection, and house style questions.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file to reduce documentation clutter.

Initial release of microtypography — a text-polishing skill for Polish and English prose.

- Automatically fixes hanging single-letter conjunctions/prepositions with non-breaking spaces (NBSP), following strict Polish and optional English conventions.
- Ensures numbers and units/currency are kept together with NBSP, and replaces x in measurements with the proper multiplication sign.
- Corrects dashes (em/en/hyphen) and quotation marks to typographically proper forms, respecting language and style context.
- Adds orphan guards (NBSP between last two words in paragraphs) and flags widow risks for post-layout review.
- Handles ragged-edge risks by rewrapping hard-wrapped text or suggesting non-destructive mitigation for reflowed content.
- Excludes code, tables, short UI strings, and content where rewriting copy is not permitted.
